description: Which design this graph holds: its durable id and its human label. The id is assigned once, with no coordination, and never changes — it namespaces every stored key and appears in every export, so two designs can tell each other apart when they compose (mirror_surface). Pass `label` to RENAME the design; the id is untouched. Read this when a session needs to say WHICH design it is working in.

label.description:
A new human-facing label for this design. The id never changes — every
stored key and every export ever written names it. Omit to just read.

name: design_identity
